grass.note: The meadow: the first grass, its closest sister over half, the open sister in patches, the worn grass in spots. Tone variation is the shader's tint, never another image.

forest.note: The floor of the woods: the flattest grass in the shade, the sparse forest grass in a few plaques, a third of the bare spots kept. Plain soil does not come out of the generator.

water.note: The river: only the generated images, turned to follow the river. No bank for now: the strip approach broke on a meandering river (it assumed a straight north-south bank); the bank will be a tileset of generated shore pieces. Decorations are sown by the decor entry.

decor.note: Decorations sown by a fixed hash of the tile (client-side trial, no effect on the game).

shore.note: Shore tileset: generated edge and corner pieces on every land/water boundary; matter by stretch along the river.
